disable_progress_bars: disable progress bars globally in the datasets library by calling disable_progress_bars
enable_progress_bars: enable progress bars globally in the datasets library by calling enable_progress_bars
are_progress_bars_disabled: check whether progress bars are globally disabled by calling are_progress_bars_disabled
tqdm_class: use the custom tqdm class to iterate with progress bars that respect global disable settings
is_progress_bar_enabled: check if progress bars are currently enabled by calling is_progress_bar_enabled
